channel.title: Joe Hartmann Finds
channel.description: Joe Hartmann Finds is a growing collection of Amazon affiliate finds from Joe Hartmann's Pinterest boards, each with a short article and links to the pin and to Amazon.

item.title: AUVON Motion Sensor Night Lights 4-Pack – Plug-in LED Dusk to Dawn Lights for Hallway & Bathroom
item.description: A closer look at the AUVON plug-in night light 4-pack, warm white LED lights with a motion sensor and a dusk-to-dawn sensor, dimmable from 1 to 50 lumens, with a compact design that leaves the second outlet free.

item.title: BISSELL Featherweight Stick Vacuum – Lightweight Bagless Vacuum & Electric Broom for Hard Floors
item.description: A closer look at the BISSELL 2033 Featherweight, a corded bagless stick vacuum that weighs under 4 pounds and converts to a hand vacuum or stair vacuum, with a crevice tool, a 15 ft cord, and a 0.67 liter dirt cup.

item.title: Clorox ToiletWand Starter Kit – Disposable Toilet Brush Wand with Caddy & Refill Heads
item.description: A closer look at the Clorox ToiletWand starter kit, with a wand, a storage caddy, and 6 disposable scrubbing pads preloaded with Clorox cleaner that pop off into the trash after use.

item.title: Shark Navigator Lift-Away Upright Vacuum NV352 – HEPA Anti-Allergen Vacuum for Pet Hair
item.description: A closer look at the Shark Navigator Lift-Away NV352, a corded upright vacuum with a detachable Lift-Away pod, swivel steering, a HEPA filter with a sealed system, an XL dust cup, and crevice and upholstery tools.

item.title: Holikme Dryer Vent Cleaner Kit – Flexible Lint Brush & Drill Attachment for Dryer Vents
item.description: A closer look at the Holikme 15 ft dryer vent cleaner kit, with a brush for 4-inch vent pipes, flexible nylon rods, a lint brush, a drill attachment, and protective gloves for DIY dryer vent cleaning.

item.title: First Alert HOME1 Fire Extinguisher – Rechargeable Standard Home Fire Extinguisher, UL Rated
item.description: A closer look at the First Alert HOME1 rechargeable fire extinguisher, UL rated 1-A:10-B:C for wood, paper, trash, plastics, gasoline, oil, and electrical equipment fires, with a metal valve, a pressure gauge, and a mounting bracket.

item.title: LEVOIT Classic300S Smart Humidifier – 6L Top Fill Cool Mist for Large Rooms & Dry Winter Air
item.description: A closer look at the LEVOIT Classic300S ultrasonic smart humidifier, with a 6L top-fill tank, up to 60 hours of runtime, auto mode with a humidity sensor, VeSync app control, and a sleep mode.

item.title: Electric Spin Scrubber – Cordless Shower & Tub Cleaning Brush with Long Handle & 8 Heads
item.description: A closer look at the Leebein electric spin scrubber, a cordless USB-C rechargeable brush with 8 replaceable heads, two speeds, a 12 to 54 inch adjustable handle, and an IPX7 waterproof rating.

item.title: OXO Good Grips Stainless Steel Squeegee – Streak-Free Shower Door, Mirror & Glass Wiper
item.description: A closer look at the OXO Good Grips stainless steel squeegee, with a flexible blade for streak-free drying, a non-slip grip that works when wet, and a suction holder for storing it in the shower.

item.title: FURemover Rubber Broom – Pet Hair Removal Broom with Squeegee for Carpet & Hard Floors
item.description: A closer look at the FURemover rubber broom, with a 12.5-inch natural rubber head for pulling pet hair out of carpet, a squeegee edge for spills and glass, and a telescopic handle that adjusts from 34 to 58 inches.

item.title: GORILLA GRIP Absorbent Door Mat – Indoor Outdoor Non-Slip Entry Mat That Traps Mud & Water
item.description: A closer look at the GORILLA GRIP HydroABSORB door mat in 29 x 17 inches, black, with a water dam border, deep grooves that scrape off dirt, a polyester topside, and a textured rubber backing for indoor or covered outdoor use.

item.title: Holikme Drill Brush Attachment Set – Power Scrubber Brushes for Grout, Tub, Tile & Shower
item.description: A closer look at the Holikme 6-piece drill brush attachment set, with 5 brush sizes and an extension rod that turn a cordless drill into a power scrubber for grout, tile, tubs, sinks, and car detailing. Drill not included.

item.title: Conair Fabric Shaver & Lint Remover – Sweater Defuzzer for Pilling Clothes & Furniture
item.description: A closer look at the Conair fabric shaver and lint remover in white, a battery-operated defuzzer with 3 depth settings, a large 2-inch shaving head, and a detachable lint catcher for sweaters, clothing, and furniture.

item.title: Kasa Smart Plug 4-Pack – Wi-Fi Outlet for Alexa & Google Home, Schedules & Timers
item.description: A closer look at the Kasa Smart Plug HS103P4 4-pack, Wi-Fi outlets that work with Alexa and Google Home, with app control from anywhere, schedules, countdown timers, and Away Mode, with no hub required.

item.title: Amazon Basics Microfiber Cleaning Cloths – Lint-Free, Ultra Absorbent Cloths for Home & Car
item.description: A closer look at Amazon Basics microfiber cleaning cloths, a 24-pack of reusable, machine washable, non-abrasive cloths in blue, white, and yellow for counters, glass, finishes, and cars.

item.title: LEVOIT Core 300 Air Purifier – Quiet HEPA Filter for Pets, Dust, Pollen & Smoke
item.description: A closer look at the LEVOIT Core 300-P air purifier, a compact cylinder for bedrooms and offices with AHAM Verifide CADR ratings for smoke, dust, and pollen, a 24dB Sleep Mode, and a 2 to 8 hour timer.

item.title: TubShroom Tub Drain Hair Catcher – Clog Prevention Drain Protector for Bathtub & Shower
item.description: A closer look at the TubShroom bathtub drain hair catcher in gray, a silicone in-drain strainer that catches human and pet hair before it becomes a clog and fits standard 1.4 to 1.75 inch tub drains.

item.title: O-Cedar EasyWring Spin Mop & Bucket – Hands-Free Wringing Microfiber Floor Cleaning System
item.description: A closer look at the O-Cedar EasyWring microfiber spin mop and bucket system, with a foot pedal for hands-free wringing, a splash guard, a triangle mop head for corners, and a machine washable microfiber head.

item.title: ChomChom Roller Pet Hair Remover – Reusable Lint Roller for Couch, Bedding & Car
item.description: A closer look at the ChomChom Roller, a reusable pet hair remover that traps dog and cat hair from couches, bedding, rugs, and car seats in a built-in chamber with no sticky sheets or adhesive.

item.title: BISSELL Little Green Portable Carpet Cleaner – Spot Cleaner for Couch, Rugs, Stairs & Car
item.description: A closer look at the BISSELL Little Green 1400B portable carpet cleaner, a spray, scrub, and suction spot cleaner with a 48 oz clean water tank for carpet, rugs, stairs, upholstery, and car interiors.

item.title: Trideer Exercise Ball – Yoga Ball for Core, Pregnancy & Active Sitting
item.description: A closer look at the Trideer Yoga Ball, a durable PVC exercise ball offered in 55, 65, and 75 cm sizes for core work, balance, stretching, pregnancy comfort, and active sitting, designed to deflate gradually if punctured.

item.title: GUGTTR Under Desk Elliptical – Low-Impact Seated Leg Exerciser with Remote
item.description: A closer look at the GUGTTR Under Desk Elliptical Machine, an electric seated leg exerciser with 12 speed levels, 3 auto programs, forward and reverse pedaling, an LCD display, a remote control, and a carry handle.

item.title: Sunny Health & Fitness Mini Stepper – Compact Stair Stepper with Resistance Bands
item.description: A closer look at the Sunny Health & Fitness Mini Stair Stepper, a compact hydraulic stepper with adjustable step height, two removable resistance bands, an LCD monitor, a 300 lb capacity, and no assembly needed.

item.title: RitFit Pilates Ring 14" – Magic Circle for Inner Thighs, Core & Home Pilates
item.description: A closer look at the RitFit Pilates Ring, a 14-inch magic fitness circle made from fiberglass with an EVA outer and padded handles inside and out, sold as a home workout set with a workout guide and storage bag.

item.title: Sportneer Adjustable Ankle Weights – Removable Weights for Walking, Pilates & Glutes
item.description: A closer look at Sportneer Adjustable Ankle Weights, a neoprene pair with removable 1 lb sandbags that adjust from 1 to 5 lb per weight (2 to 10 lb per pair), a metal D-ring, and long hook-and-loop straps.

item.title: ZELUS Weighted Vest – Adjustable Weight Vest for Walking, Running & Strength
item.description: A closer look at the ZELUS Weighted Vest, an iron-sand weight vest offered in several weights from 6 to 30 lb, with adjustable buckle straps, Lycra and SBR fabric, arm pockets, and 360° reflective strips.

item.title: BlenderBottle Sport Flip Shaker Bottle 28 oz – Protein Shake Cup with Whisk Ball
item.description: A closer look at the BlenderBottle Sport Flip, a 28-ounce Eastman Tritan shaker bottle with the stainless steel BlenderBall whisk, a push-button flip cap with a sliding lock, a wide mouth, and dishwasher-safe care.

item.title: Fitgriff Gym Bag – Duffle Bag with Shoe Compartment & Wet Pocket for Men & Women
item.description: A closer look at the Fitgriff Gym Bag, a multi-purpose duffle for men and women with a ventilated shoe compartment, a waterproof wet pocket, a waterproof base, and six separate pockets for gym, travel, and weekend trips.

item.title: RENPHO Smart Scale – Bluetooth Body Fat Scale with 13 Body Metrics & App
item.description: A closer look at the RENPHO Smart Scale (Elis 1), a Bluetooth bathroom scale that shows weight, BMI, and body fat, tracks 13 body metrics in the RENPHO Health app, and syncs with apps like Apple Health, Samsung Health, and Fitbit.

item.title: ATERCEL Workout Gloves – Padded Weight Lifting Gloves with Wrist Wrap for Men & Women
item.description: A closer look at ATERCEL Workout Gloves, lightweight, breathable exercise gloves for men and women with a grip-focused palm, adjustable wraps, a pull loop system, and five snug-fit sizes.

item.title: Yagud Under Desk Walking Pad Treadmill – 2-in-1 Treadmill for Home Office
item.description: A closer look at the Yagud Under Desk Treadmill, a compact walking pad with a 2.5 HP motor, 0 to 3.8 MPH speeds, a 5-layer non-slip belt, an LED display, and a remote control for home and office use.

item.title: Ally Peaks Doorway Pull Up Bar – No-Screw Chin Up Bar for Home Gym, 440 lb
item.description: A closer look at the Ally Peaks Doorway Pull Up Bar, a no-screw, leverage-mounted chin-up bar in 1.7mm thickened steel with foam multi-grip handles, silicone door-frame protection, and a listed 440 lb max.

item.title: Vinsguir Ab Roller Wheel – Core Strength Trainer for Home Workouts
item.description: A closer look at the Vinsguir Ab Roller Wheel, a 2-inch-wide, slightly rounded ab wheel with a steel core, finger-grooved EVA foam handles, and a textured non-slip wheel for core workouts at home.

item.title: TriggerPoint GRID Foam Roller – 13" Multi-Density Roller for Deep Muscle Recovery
item.description: A closer look at the TriggerPoint GRID 1.0 Foam Roller, a 13-inch multi-density roller with a three-dimensional GRID surface and an EVA-foam-wrapped hollow core for muscle recovery and mobility work.

item.title: HPYGN Weighted Jump Rope – Heavy Skipping Rope for Full-Body Strength & Cardio
item.description: A closer look at the HPYGN Weighted Jump Rope, a heavy 9.2 ft skipping rope made from high-density polymer synthetic fiber, with anti-slip handles and a portable bag, offered in several weights.

item.title: Amazon Basics Cast Iron Kettlebell – Textured Wide Handle for Swings & Strength
item.description: A closer look at the Amazon Basics Cast Iron Kettlebell, a single-piece solid cast iron kettlebell with a wide textured handle for one- or two-handed swings, squats, presses, and rows.

item.title: TOLOCO Massage Gun – Deep Tissue Percussion Muscle Massager with 10 Heads
item.description: A closer look at the TOLOCO Massage Gun, a cordless deep tissue percussion massager with 10 interchangeable heads, multiple speed levels, an LED touch screen, USB charging, and a quiet brushless motor.

item.title: Gaiam Essentials Thick Yoga Mat – Extra Cushion Exercise Mat with Carrying Strap
item.description: A closer look at the Gaiam Essentials Thick Yoga Mat, a 10mm NBR foam exercise mat with a textured surface, wipe-clean care, and an adjustable easy-cinch carrying strap for yoga, Pilates, and floor workouts.

item.title: Fit Simplify Resistance Loop Bands Set of 5 – Booty Bands for Glutes, Legs & Pilates
item.description: A closer look at the Fit Simplify Resistance Loop Exercise Bands, a set of five color-coded latex loop bands from extra light to extra heavy, with a carry bag and an illustrated instruction guide.

item.title: Adjustable Dumbbell Set of 2 – 5-in-1 Quick-Change Weights for a Small Home Gym
item.description: A closer look at the FDB2 adjustable dumbbell set of 2 from LifeOG, a 5-in-1 pair that changes weight on its storage base, with cast iron plates in a PE shell, a textured rubber grip, and a dual-lock system.

item.title: Oversized Wearable Blanket Sweatshirt – Giant Blanket Hoodie for Women & Men
item.description: A look at an oversized wearable blanket sweatshirt with a big plush hood, roomy sleeves, and a giant front pocket, long enough to keep you warm from head to legs on cold nights.

item.title: Women's Fluffy Fleece Pajama Set – Cozy Ribbed Pullover & Pants PJs
item.description: A look at a women's two-piece fleece pajama set with a long sleeve crew neck pullover, ribbed cuffs and collar, and matching full-length pants with an elastic waistband.

item.title: Amazon Essentials Men's Fleece Open Bottom Sweatpants – Comfy Lounge Pants
item.description: A look at the Amazon Essentials men's fleece open bottom sweatpant, with a relaxed straight leg, an elastic drawstring waistband, on-seam side pockets, and Big & Tall sizes.

item.title: The Original Eden Weighted Hoodie Cloak – Plush Faux Fur Lined Wearable Blanket
item.description: A closer look at the Free The Sheep Eden Hoodie, an oversized unisex hoodie cloak with a soft 4 lb interior weight and a full plush faux fur lining for lounging, reading, and travel.

item.title: Women's Oversized Cable Knit Cardigan – Cute Sheep Embroidered Button V-Neck Sweater
item.description: A look at a women's cable knit open front cardigan with sheep embroidery, a V-neck, rainbow buttons, two side pockets, and a relaxed, hip-length fit for fall and winter.

item.title: Trendy Queen Women's Oversized Cable Knit Sweater – Chunky Crewneck Pullover
item.description: A closer look at the Trendy Queen Women's Oversized Cable Knit Sweater, a cotton-blend crewneck pullover with a classic cable knit pattern and a relaxed, oversized fit for fall and winter layering.

item.title: PRETTYGARDEN Women's Chunky Cable Knit Cardigan – Oversized Button Sweater Coat
item.description: A closer look at the PRETTYGARDEN Women's Chunky Cable Knit Cardigan, a loose-fit button-front sweater with twist cable texture, ribbed cuffs and hem, and pockets.

item.title: Amazon Essentials Women's Fleece Quarter-Zip Pullover Sweatshirt – Cozy Everyday Layer
item.description: A closer look at the Amazon Essentials Women's Long-Sleeve Fleece Quarter-Zip Pullover, a classic-fit cotton-blend sweatshirt with a mock neck, a quarter zip, and a kangaroo pocket.

item.title: AUTOMET Women's 2 Piece Lounge Set – Oversized Hoodie & Jogger Matching Sweat Set
item.description: A closer look at the AUTOMET Women's 2 Piece Lounge Set, a matching cotton-polyester fleece sweat set with a drop-shoulder hoodie and relaxed joggers with side pockets.

item.title: AUTOMET Women's Half Zip Fleece Pullover – Oversized Cropped Sweatshirt Fall Outfit
item.description: A closer look at the AUTOMET Women's Half Zip Fleece Pullover, a relaxed, drop-shoulder sweatshirt with a soft fleece lining, a half-zip stand collar, thumb holes, and a front kangaroo pocket.
